Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 27

“Others offer all the functions of the senses and the functions of the breath into the fire of self-restraint, kindled by knowledge.”

The offering moves inward again, now consuming even the involuntary. Note that the fire must be lit by knowledge — restraint on its own has nothing to burn with.
